option_relations.rationale: Foreign body aspiration (fish bone) is a component of the leaf diagnosis, but the leaf specifies 'with obstructive pneumonia', making the option a less complete diagnosis.

The option 'Obstructive pneumonia due to bronchial foreign body (fish bone)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Foreign body aspiration (fish bone) with obstructive pneumonia'. Both describe the same condition where a fish bone leads to obstructive pneumonia.
This option suggests an endobronchial lesion like a tumor or stricture as the cause of post-obstructive pneumonia, which is different from a foreign body aspiration described in the leaf.
Pneumonia is a general term. The leaf specifies 'Foreign body aspiration (fish bone) with obstructive pneumonia', which is a more specific type of pneumonia.
